senses.gloss: (enlargement of פָּרַן) to endow, provide, sustain, cultivate.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 69b:9">B. Mets. 69ᵇ</cite> <he>אֲפַרְנְסֶנָּה</he> I will improve the field, v. <cite ref="Q01879"><he>פָּרַן</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 43">Ex. R. s. 43</cite>, end <he>לך פַּרְנְסָהּ ועשה וכ׳</he> go and improve it, and make a vineyard of it.

<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 5:2">Keth. V, 2</cite> <he>נותנין … לפַרְנֵס את עצמה</he> a betrothed maiden is given twelve months time … to make her outfit; <he>כך … לפרנס את עצמו</he> so is the man allowed a certain time to prepare himself.
Tosef. B. Mets. VII, 6 פַּרְנֵס לי מלאכה וכ׳ provide work for me on thy own property, or give me my wages &c.; a. fr.—Esp. to provide with the necessaries of life; to support (from the charities).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 8a:8">B. Bath. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>במה אֲפַרְנֶסְךָ</he> on what claim shall I support thee?; <he>פַּרְנְסֵנִי ככלב וכ׳</he> support me as you would a dog or a raven.

<cite ref="Gittin 61a:5">Gitt. 61ᵃ</cite> <he>מְפַרְנְסִין עניי נכרים וכ׳</he> we are bound to support the gentile poor equally with the Jewish poor because of ‘the ways of peace’, v. <cite ref="D01096"><he>דֶּרֶךְ</he></cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Gittin 5:4">Tosef. ib. V</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Gittin 3:4">III</cite>), 4; a. v. fr.—

<cite ref="Bava Batra 14a:11">B. Bath. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>פִּירְנַסְתָּה … צא ופַרְנֵס ארון לרחבו</he> thou hast made provision (explained how) to fill up the Ark in its length, go and fill it in its width.

senses.gloss: to be provided for, be supported; to support one’s self.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 4:14">Kidd. IV, 14</cite> <he>והן מִתְפַּרְנְסִין שלא בצער</he> and they (beasts and birds) are provided for without any trouble of their own; <he>אינו דין שאֶתְפַּרְנֵס וכ׳</he> might it not be a proper inference that I (a human being) ought to be sustained without trouble? <cite ref="Ketubot 67b:8">Keth. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>אין לו ואינו רוצה להִתְפּרְנֵס וכ׳</he> if a person has no means and refuses to be supported (from the charities).
<cite ref="Ketubot 67b:9">Ib.</cite> <he>יש לו ואינו ואינו רוצה להתפרנס</he> if a person has means but refuses to supply himself with the necessaries of life (preferring to starve himself).
<cite ref="Berakhot 28a:9">Ber. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>אי אתה יודע … מִתְפַּרְנְסִים וכ׳</he> thou knowest nothing of the trouble of the scholars,—how they support themselves and what they live on.
<cite ref="Ketubot 68a:9">Keth. 68ᵃ</cite> <he>הבנות ניזונות וּמִתְפַּרְנְסוֹת וכ׳</he> daughters must be fed and provided for (clothed) from their father’s estate.
<cite ref="Berakhot 3b:29">Ber. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>לכו והִתְפַּרְנְסוּ זה מזה</he> go and support yourselves by dealing with one another; a. v. fr.
